# https://buyiptvnorway.com

NorwayIPTV is Norway's #1 IPTV service with 50,000+ live channels in HD and 4K.

## About
- Service: Premium IPTV streaming (IP Television)
- Markets served: Norway (primary), Sweden, Denmark, Finland, United Kingdom, Canada, United States, Australia, New Zealand, Germany, France, Netherlands, Poland, and European diaspora communities
- Price: From €9/month (1 month) to €49/year (12 months)
- Free trial: Yes — 24-hour free trial via WhatsApp
- Contact: https://wa.me/17828026280

## Key Facts
- 50,000+ live channels including NRK, TV2, Viaplay, Premier League, Eliteserien, Champions League
- 300,000+ movies and series (VOD)
- 4K HDR quality on compatible channels
- 99.5% uptime on enterprise server infrastructure
- Compatible apps: TiviMate, IPTV Smarters Pro, Smart IPTV, GSE Smart IPTV, NET IPTV, SET IPTV, iPlayTV, Nanomid, IPTV Extreme Pro
- Compatible devices: Firestick, Samsung Smart TV, LG Smart TV, Apple TV, Android TV, Nvidia Shield, Formuler, MAG boxes, iPhone, Android phones
